video.title: What is Forward Deployed Engineer role? What Does a FDE Actually Do? #tech #ai

transcript.text: Forward deployed engineer or FDE is one
of the highest paid roles in tech today
with companies like Google, Nvidia,
OpenAI hiring aggressively. So, what
exactly does a forward deployed engineer
do? So, most engineers work in their
companies and build products for their
own users, but FDE does the opposite.
They go directly into customers
environment and make things work there.
So, if a large enterprise buys an AI
product, FDE is usually the engineer
that will help them deploy it in real
world. So, things like understanding
clients existing system, integrating
everything together, and making sure
that it runs in real production system.
Everyday work for an FDE could be
setting up infrastructure on AWS,
writing scripts to integrate APIs,
deploying AI agents, building rack
pipelines or automation workflow, or
maybe debugging a Kubernetes cluster. To
land an FDE role, you need to have
hands-on experience with technologies
like Kubernetes, REST API, cloud
platforms like AWS or Azure, even
Python, vector databases, automation
tools like N8N, or even LLM frameworks
like LangChain. If you want a complete
step-by-step road map to become an FDE,
comment below forward deployed engineer
and I might create a complete video.
